_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with record bookings ($33.3B in FY13); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2013 10-K names off-shore providers, 'particularly in India, the Philippines and China ... often at highly competitive prices and on more aggressive contractual terms', among its competitors and says competitors 'may be willing, at times, to price contracts lower than us' and that its own delivery network 'is increasingly concentrated in India and the Philippines', while its own Global Delivery Network grew to 182,000+ people. The stock trades at 17.4x FY14E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

Live: Accenture's own FY2013 10-K says 'Current areas of significant change include mobility, cloud-based computing and the processing and analyzing of large amounts of data. Technological developments such as these may materially affect the cost and use of technology by our clients.' At the same time it sells cloud services itself, bridging 'traditional and cloud environments through the Accenture Cloud Platform'. The stock trades at 17.4x FY14E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with record bookings ($33.3B in FY13); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.86x; +34% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.78; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.6%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.9%/yr (FY03-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2014-08-01) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.86x (27.6% downside to Bear $57 / +32.1% upside to Bull $104) | Adj composite 2.07 vs market 2.85: gap -0.78 [OVERVALUED] | +34% above the EPP floor $59 (13x FY14E $4.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.8% total (+1.4%/yr) | At 17.4x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $104 sits above the BULL case; consulting +5% LC in Q3, FY14 guided +4-5% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
